proposed_comments.title: Limit WM_MENUCHAR suppression to shelf shortcuts
proposed_comments.body:
### Limit `WM_MENUCHAR` suppression to shelf shortcuts

**Severity:** `medium`

The handler currently returns `MNC_CLOSE` for every `WM_MENUCHAR` message received by the window, so unrelated menu mnemonics are swallowed along with the shelf shortcuts. Scope the suppression to the low-word character for Alt+0 through Alt+9, preserving normal handling for every other mnemonic.

```suggestion
            // Suppress the system chime for the shelf's Alt+0 through Alt+9 access keys,
            // while preserving the normal handling of other window mnemonics.
            case PInvoke.WM_MENUCHAR when (wParam.Value & 0xFFFF) is >= (nuint)'0' and <= (nuint)'9':
```
